name: Valeria Foster
original_name: ヴァレリア・フォースター
source:
The only daughter of the fallen aristocrat family, Foster. She adores Selma and often comes to the Fostermayer estate. Having a gentle and fluffy personality, she sometimes scuffles with Selma. These scuffles look like noisy messing. For some reason, she believes she is being treated unfairly when it comes to happiness.
